body_en: Public rules protect everyone: wait in line, clean up, follow lab safety. Breaking rules for fun can hurt others. If a rule seems wrong, discuss it with teachers instead of quiet fight-back. Being a good member of the school starts in the hallways.
body_zh: 公共规则保护所有人：排队、清理、遵守实验安全。图好玩犯规可能伤人。觉得规则不对，就和老师讨论，而不是暗地对抗。做学校里的好成员，从走廊开始。
